name: eMudhra

bull.point: Full-year FY26 total income expanded 35% year-on-year to ₹713.2 crore, delivering on annual revenue guidance of ₹700 crore.

bull.point: Enterprise Solutions revenue surged 50% year-on-year in Q1 FY27 to ₹162.3 crore, driving overall segment growth.

evidence.quote: Enterprise Solutions remained our primary growth engine, growing approximately 50% YoY, and contributing 65% of total income
The Enterprise Solutions segment generated revenue of INR 1,623 while the Trust Service revenue was INR 284 million

bull.point: Q2 FY27 revenue reached ₹207 crore with net profit rising 26.9% year-on-year to ₹33 crore and EBITDA margin reaching 24.0%.
